en: At seminary, we pastors have a song like this:
"To Achor's valley, to the barren fields, I'll go... as far as Daejeon!"
People who became pastors around Seoul
don't want to move out to the provinces.

text:
그래서 "아골 골짝 빈 들에도
대전까지 가오리라"
en: So they sing, "I'll go as far as Daejeon,"
How hard it is for God to work with us.

text:
그럼 뭐 *대구*까지 가는 게
유배지에 끌려가는 것같이
en: Going as far as Daegu? Like being dragged into exile,

text:
하나님이 내 인생에
허락하신 모든 것이

en: we get dragged along. That's us.
I want to refresh God's heart
That's the wish of my heart.
